title: No pre-SRH Hop-Limit discard: srh_hop_limit_0_reject vector undrivable
description: test/vectors/source_route_hop_limit.json vector srh_hop_limit_0_reject requires rejection (reason hop_limit_exhausted) when Hop Limit = 0 ('packet should already be discarded before SRH processing'). No Python surface implements this: lichen.rpl.routing.advance_source_route() short-circuits Segments Left == 0 (final destination) BEFORE its segments_left >= hop_limit check, and no receive-path hop_limit==0 gate exists elsewhere in python/src (grep verified). Current actual behavior is pinned by test_srh_hop_limit_zero_documented_divergence in python/tests/test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py (returns accept-as-final-destination); that test MUST be inverted once a pre-SRH hop-limit discard is added. Vector partition enforced by test_srh_hop_limit_vector_coverage.
